ELEKTRO-L 2 is a weather satellite to help civilian and military forecasters track storm systems, collecting near-realtime images of weather systems from Europe to the Asia-Pacific, joining an international fleet of geostationary weather satellites owned by the United States, Europe, India, China and Japan. ELEKTRO-L 2 will be positioned at 77.8 degrees east longitude, where its weather sensors will track storms with an image refresh rate of about 30 minutes.
